items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names and comments are mostly clear. However, the custom Config.UnmarshalYAML key normalization has no comment explaining it, and decryptor.go uses bare numbers like `dr.br.Buffered() >= 36` and `chunkLen < NonceSize+16`, so the sentinel/peek logic is hard to follow.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: decryptReader.Read runs to roughly 90 lines and contains the sentinel/HMAC check twice: once in the normal path and again in the Peek fast path. UnmarshalYAML adds a speculative second decode with fallback keys. decodeBase64 tries four encodings in a row.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are handled and truncation is detected. But constants are hard-coded (100000 iterations, 36, 16, 32). decodeBase64 quietly accepts any of four encodings. Job.Validate returns the encryption error without wrapping or job context.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: The mandated changes are done and unencrypted output is unchanged. But storage.PathGenerator keeps its 2-arg signature and passes a hard-coded `EnsureFileName(filename, gzip, false, unique)` instead of updating callers. The agent also added Config.UnmarshalYAML, which accepts extra YAML key variants.

validity_flags.basis: existing test lines changed/removed (4): fileutil/fileutil_test.go; existing test lines changed/removed (2): handler/jobhandler_test.go
